maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.cadence: Official notice board, read every minute
maintenance.allServers_one: Announced for the {{count, number}} Global server.
maintenance.allServers_other: Announced for all {{count, number}} Global servers.
maintenance.someServers_one: Announced for {{count, number}} of {{total, number}} Global servers.
maintenance.someServers_other: Announced for {{count, number}} of {{total, number}} Global servers.
maintenance.staleHint: The last check is old or the newest one failed, so this may have changed. Reminders are never paused on an uncertain check.
maintenance.unreachableHint: Reminders are never paused until a check succeeds.
maintenance.nowHint: A published schedule, not a live check: servers can open earlier or later than announced.
maintenance.scheduleHint: From the official notices for Global servers. Outside an announced window they can’t tell whether a server is up.
maintenance.notifyBack: Notify me when maintenance is complete
maintenance.notifyBackHint: Once, when the official notice marks it complete, never at the estimated end. Sounds and pops up even with notifications off or AION closed; mute and quiet hours still apply. Keep Aion Companion running (the tray is enough).
maintenance.overdue: Estimated end passed; awaiting official completion
maintenance.uncovered: The official notices read here cover Global servers only, so they say nothing about {{region}}; reminders there are never paused for maintenance.
